reason: Ten registered tools implement GTM v2 collection reads and prefix-governed workspace/tag/trigger/variable creation.
exposure: All ten decorators register unconditionally. GTM_WORKSPACE_PREFIX changes write guardrails (default IA | ) but does not change exposure.
limitations: Offline FastMCP.list_tools registration only; no handlers, authentication, or GTM operations were executed. Dependencies are lower-bound-only; schemas reflect installed mcp 1.30.0.

Creation payload dict parameters are deliberately unrestricted objects, with no GTM resource-specific fields validated locally. Read collection handlers do not follow nextPageToken, so may return only the first page.

tools.name: list_gtm_accounts
tools.description: List all Google Tag Manager accounts accessible with your active credentials.
tools.behavior: GETs the GTM v2 accounts collection using Application Default Credentials.

tools.name: list_gtm_containers
tools.description:
List GTM containers for a given account.

Args:
    parent: The parent account path (e.g., 'accounts/123456')
tools.behavior: GETs the GTM v2 containers collection under the supplied parent path.

tools.name: list_gtm_workspaces
tools.description:
List workspaces inside a GTM container.

Args:
    parent: The parent container path (e.g., 'accounts/123456/containers/78901')
tools.behavior: GETs the GTM v2 workspaces collection under the supplied parent path.

tools.name: list_gtm_tags
tools.description:
List tags inside a GTM workspace.

Args:
    parent: The workspace path (e.g., 'accounts/123456/containers/78901/workspaces/12')
tools.behavior: GETs the GTM v2 tags collection under the supplied parent path.

tools.name: list_gtm_triggers

Args:
    parent: The workspace path (e.g., 'accounts/123456/containers/78901/workspaces/12')
tools.behavior: GETs the GTM v2 triggers collection under the supplied parent path.

tools.name: list_gtm_variables
tools.description:

Args:
    parent: The workspace path (e.g., 'accounts/123456/containers/78901/workspaces/12')
tools.behavior: GETs the GTM v2 variables collection under the supplied parent path.

tools.name: create_gtm_workspace
tools.description:
Create a new workspace in a GTM container. Enforces strict naming conventions.

Args:
    parent: The parent container path (e.g., 'accounts/123456/containers/78901')
    name: The name of the workspace. MUST start with the governance prefix (default 'IA | ', override with GTM_WORKSPACE_PREFIX)
    description: Optional description of the workspace.
tools.behavior: Rejects names without the configured prefix, then POSTs a workspace name and optional description under the container.

tools.name: create_gtm_tag
tools.description:
Create a new tag in a GTM workspace. Enforced to only run in workspaces matching the governance prefix (default 'IA | ').

Args:
    parent: The parent workspace path (e.g., 'accounts/123456/containers/78901/workspaces/12')
    tag_data: The JSON payload for the tag (matching GTM API v2 schema)
tools.behavior: GETs the target workspace to verify its configured name prefix, then POSTs the unrestricted supplied tag payload.

tools.name: create_gtm_trigger
tools.description:
Create a new trigger in a GTM workspace. Enforced to only run in workspaces matching the governance prefix (default 'IA | ').

Args:
    parent: The parent workspace path (e.g., 'accounts/123456/containers/78901/workspaces/12')
    trigger_data: The JSON payload for the trigger (matching GTM API v2 schema)
tools.behavior: GETs the target workspace to verify its configured name prefix, then POSTs the unrestricted supplied trigger payload.

tools.name: create_gtm_variable
tools.description:
Create a new variable in a GTM workspace. Enforced to only run in workspaces matching the governance prefix (default 'IA | ').

Args:
    parent: The parent workspace path (e.g., 'accounts/123456/containers/78901/workspaces/12')
    variable_data: The JSON payload for the variable (matching GTM API v2 schema)
tools.behavior: GETs the target workspace to verify its configured name prefix, then POSTs the unrestricted supplied variable payload.

review.summary: Browses container entities and creates tags, triggers, and variables only in workspaces matching a configured prefix.
